ai.title: FDPPI, MYRA join hands to strengthen data protection education
ai.description: In a move aimed at strengthening India’s capabilities in data protection, privacy and artificial intelligence (AI) governance and digital trust, the Foundation of Data Protection Professionals in India (FDPPI) and MYRA School of Business, Mysuru, signed a MoU on Wednesday to collaborate in education, research, professional certification and capacity building.

ai.title: Samsung AI demand drives record chip earnings amid foundry and mobile hurdles
ai.description: Samsung's AI boom lifts chips, tests foundry and mobile units, according to a news report by The Korea Herald. Samsung Electronics' semiconductor business delivered its strongest-ever second-quarter performance, fueled by booming demand for artificial intelligence server memory that pushed revenue and operating profit to record highs.
ai.title_cn: 在代工和移动障碍中，三星人工智能需求推动创纪录的芯片盈利
ai.description_cn: 据《韩国先驱报》报道，三星的人工智能热潮提升了芯片、测试了代工厂和移动设备。三星电子（Samsung Electronics）的半导体业务在第二季度实现了有史以来最强劲的业绩，这得益于对人工智能服务器内存的需求激增，将收入和营业利润推至创纪录高位。
